versions.changelog: 在skill中规范用户配置信息的存储位置，以后会存放在工作区而非skill目录下，这样就可以一直持久化存储而不会因为更新丢失了。

awesome-closet-stylist v1.0.2

- keeps the skill high-autonomy, while making its operating boundaries clearer
- unifies the core state model and terminology across the main spec and sub-specs
- clarifies how the skill handles facts, writes, confirmation, and tool usage
- improves handling for multi-intent requests, temporary constraints, and sparse wardrobes
- expands eval coverage for recommendation quality, deletion safety, and no-invention behavior
- keeps the packaged release content English-only for consistency

Initial release.

- Persistently manages your personal wardrobe and preferences.
- Enables natural-language wardrobe Q&A and outfit recommendations based on existing clothes.
- Supports wardrobe maintenance (add/modify/delete/filter items) and micro-adjustments to recommendations.
- Allows photo-assisted clothing entry, and quietly updates notes and preferences during conversation.
- Clearly outlines data usage and rules for safe, natural interaction—never asks for unnecessary information.
- Prepares for optional automated preferences syncing via OpenClaw hooks if the environment allows.

awesome-closet-stylist 1.0.0

- Initial release of a natural-language wardrobe assistant.
- Enables users to record, edit, and manage clothing items.
- Supports outfit recommendations based on existing wardrobe, preferences, context, and weather.
- Allows filtering and querying wardrobe items by season, color, style, or category.
- Integrates personal style preferences and notes for improved recommendations.
- Guides new users to set up their wardrobe and optional weather integration.
